# builders/ — GENERATED, do not edit

These pages are build output from the ABCD.EARTH repo (`artex-osx/docs/mockups/`), built from the app's own
seed. Edit the source there and republish:

    python3 artex-osx/docs/mockups/publish_builders.py --to <this folder>

`BUILD.json` records the ABCD commit and seed they were built from; `--check` reports a stale copy.
